prompt: Read issue.txt and the run notes. Determine which parts of the filter change have been verified and what is still needed to report completion. Describe a representative acceptance test for the filter behavior.

assertions.description: The report identifies the stale native result and requires a rerun on the current source before counting it.
The report records the browser check as blocked with the missing runner reason and does not claim completion.
The proposed acceptance test checks observable filtering behavior with representative inputs and would fail for the missing behavior.
